title: Dak Nong geopark in two days
summary: Day one stays on the Gia Nghia crossroads and the road to Ta Dung. Day two is Dray Sap on the Serepok. The handbook puts that waterfall about 110 km from town, so do not stack it on a lake morning.

days.title: Day 1 — Gia Nghia and the lake road
days.body: Highways 14 and 28, a coffee stop on the basalt, and Lieng Nung or EXPLORASOUND if you are driving. Ta Dung is about 45 km southeast when the boat is the morning.

days.title: Day 2 — Dray Sap
days.body: The provincial handbook puts Dray Sap about 110 km from Gia Nghia, in Dak Sor, Krong No. UNESCO describes a cascade about 100 metres wide. A cave visit at C9 needs an authorized guide.

stops.name: Gia Nghia crossroads
stops.note: QL14 and QL28. Lieng Nung is about 9 km out. The Dak Kar hall is about 9 km toward Da Lat. EXPLORASOUND is on Dak Nur hill.

stops.name: Vietnamese coffee
stops.note: A stop on the basalt farms around Gia Nghia. The handbook names coffee as a flagship crop.

stops.name: Dray Sap Waterfall
stops.note: Day two. About 110 km from Gia Nghia. The gate price and the time on site are Check on arrival.

stops.name: Da Lat pairing
stops.note: Use this when Lien Khuong is the flight and Ta Dung is on the same trip. Vex Sapa puts Gia Nghia to Da Lat at about 180 km.

seoTitle: Dak Nong in two days — Gia Nghia to Dray Sap
seoDescription: Two days from Gia Nghia: the road to Ta Dung, then Dray Sap about 110 km away on the Serepok. Gate prices are Check on arrival.
